title: Meeting Archbishop Marcinkus at the Vatican Bank

tellings.quote: and I and I looked up and he said we know about you from your boyhood with a lot of our associates in the mafia.

plain: Harold Malmgren, a man described as a former adviser to US presidents, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a visit to the Vatican Bank, the Catholic Church's own bank in Vatican City, in 1973, in a story that also involves a man named Pete Peterson. Malmgren says he met Archbishop Marcinkus, a senior churchman there, who looked up and told him they knew about him from his boyhood, through many of their associates in the Mafia. He tells it as a sign of how far hidden networks of power reached.
